title: GST 114 ( UNN ) : CHAPTER FOUR ( PHRASAL AND CLAUSAL CONSTITUENTS )
subject: GST 114

questions.question: The sentence structure is composed of which elements?
questions.explanation: The chapter focuses on phrases and clauses as constituents of the sentence structure.

questions.question: Which term refers to a group of words that does not contain a finite verb?
questions.explanation: A phrase is a group of words that does not contain a finite verb.

questions.question: A phrase is a group of words that lacks which element?
questions.explanation: A phrase lacks a finite verb and cannot stand alone.

questions.question: Which phrase consists of a main verb and its auxiliaries?
questions.explanation: A verb phrase consists of a main verb and its auxiliaries.

questions.question: Which phrase starts with a preposition?
questions.explanation: A prepositional phrase begins with a preposition and ends with a noun.

questions.question: A noun phrase can function as which of the following?
questions.explanation: A noun phrase functions as a subject, object, or complement.

questions.question: Which verb phrase type takes a direct object?
questions.explanation: A transitive verb phrase takes a direct object.

questions.question: Which verb phrase type does not take a direct object?
questions.explanation: An intransitive verb phrase does not take a direct object.

questions.question: Which function does an adjective phrase perform when it follows a linking verb?
questions.explanation: An adjective phrase is predicative when it follows a linking verb.

questions.question: An adverb phrase can modify which of the following?
questions.explanation: An adverb phrase can modify a verb, adjective, or another adverb.

questions.question: An adverbial phrase functions as which part of speech?
questions.explanation: An adverbial phrase functions as an adverb in a sentence.

questions.question: Which phrase is a group of words consisting of a preposition and its object?
questions.explanation: A prepositional phrase consists of a preposition and its object.

questions.question: When a prepositional phrase functions as an adjective, it is called?
questions.explanation: A prepositional phrase functioning as an adjective is called an adjectival phrase.

questions.question: A prepositional phrase can function as which of the following?
questions.explanation: A prepositional phrase can function as a noun, adjective, or adverb.

questions.question: An infinitive phrase can function as which of the following?
questions.explanation: An infinitive phrase can function as a subject, object, or complement.

questions.question: Which type of infinitive indicates an action completed before the main verb?
questions.explanation: The perfect infinitive indicates an action completed before the main verb.

questions.question: Which type of infinitive indicates a passive action?
questions.explanation: The passive infinitive indicates a passive action.

questions.question: A participle phrase functions as which part of speech?
questions.explanation: A participle phrase functions as an adjective.

questions.question: Which participle phrase ends in -ing?
questions.explanation: The present participle ends in -ing.

questions.question: A gerund phrase functions as which part of speech?
questions.explanation: A gerund phrase functions as a noun.

questions.question: A gerund phrase can function as which of the following?
questions.explanation: A gerund phrase can function as a subject, object, or complement.

questions.question: A clause contains which two essential elements?
questions.explanation: A clause contains a subject and a predicate.

questions.question: Which type of clause can stand alone as a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: A main clause can stand alone as a complete sentence.

questions.question: Which type of clause cannot stand alone as a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: A subordinate or dependent clause cannot stand alone.

questions.question: Which subordinate clause functions as a noun?
questions.explanation: A noun clause functions as a noun.

questions.question: Which subordinate clause functions as an adjective?
questions.explanation: A relative clause functions as an adjective.

questions.question: Which subordinate clause functions as an adverb?
questions.explanation: An adverbial clause functions as an adverb.

questions.question: Which adverbial clause answers the question "when"?
questions.explanation: An adverbial clause of time answers the question "when".

questions.question: Which adverbial clause answers the question "where"?
questions.explanation: An adverbial clause of place answers the question "where".

questions.question: Which adverbial clause answers the question "why"?
questions.explanation: An adverbial clause of reason answers the question "why".

questions.question: Which adverbial clause expresses a contrast?
questions.explanation: An adverbial clause of concession or contrast expresses a contrast.

questions.question: Which adverbial clause shows the result of an action?
questions.explanation: An adverbial clause of result shows the result of an action.

questions.question: Which adverbial clause indicates the degree or extent?
questions.explanation: An adverbial clause of degree indicates the degree or extent.

questions.question: In the sentence "The old man walked slowly", "slowly" is which type of phrase?
questions.explanation: Slowly functions as an adverb phrase modifying the verb walked.

questions.question: In the phrase "in the garden", what is the function?
questions.explanation: The prepositional phrase "in the garden" functions as an adverbial phrase.

questions.question: A phrase that contains a noun and its modifiers is called?
questions.explanation: A noun phrase contains a noun and its modifiers.

questions.question: "To err is human" contains an example of which phrase?
questions.explanation: "To err" is an infinitive phrase functioning as the subject.

questions.question: "Running quickly, he caught the bus" contains an example of which phrase?
questions.explanation: "Running quickly" is a participle phrase modifying "he".

questions.question: "Swimming is good exercise" contains an example of which phrase?
questions.explanation: "Swimming" is a gerund phrase functioning as the subject.

questions.question: A sentence that contains one main clause and one subordinate clause is called?
questions.explanation: A complex sentence contains one main clause and at least one subordinate clause.

questions.question: The sentence "I know that he is coming" contains which type of clause?
questions.explanation: "That he is coming" is a noun clause functioning as the object.

questions.question: The sentence "The book that I bought is new" contains which type of clause?
questions.explanation: "That I bought" is a relative clause modifying "book".

questions.question: The sentence "I will go if it rains" contains which type of clause?
questions.explanation: "If it rains" is an adverbial clause of condition.

questions.question: The sentence "He was so tired that he fell asleep" contains which type of clause?
questions.explanation: "That he fell asleep" is an adverbial clause of result.

questions.question: The sentence "Although he was tired, he finished the work" contains which type of clause?
questions.explanation: "Although he was tired" is an adverbial clause of concession.

questions.question: A clause that functions as an adverb and modifies a verb is called?
questions.explanation: An adverbial clause modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb.

questions.question: A clause that provides additional information about a noun is called?
questions.explanation: A relative clause provides additional information about a noun.

questions.question: Which phrase contains a preposition, its object, and any modifiers?
questions.explanation: A prepositional phrase contains a preposition, its object, and any modifiers.

questions.question: Which function does a noun phrase perform when it renames another noun?
questions.explanation: An appositive is a noun phrase that renames another noun beside it.

questions.question: A group of words that contains a subject and a predicate is called?
questions.explanation: A clause is a group of words that contains a subject and a predicate.
